reasons.plausibility: Adding 2–3 at.% Al to equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr to form a protective Al2O3 scale is scientifically sound, as Al has a high oxygen affinity and similar strategies work in other refractory alloys, though the claim that it will not destabilize the single-phase solid solution is uncertain given the complex multi-principal element system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on scale continuity and mechanical property retention, though the test temperature (900 °C) differs from the stated condition range (800–1000 °C) and cyclic oxidation is not included.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the research question with a specific, actionable intervention and a well-defined testing protocol, making it highly useful for guiding experimental work on this exact alloy.
